escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark space at night with a thin haze; far behind her, softly out of focus, an immense field of thousands of unlit dark glass cards recedes into the darkness): a MEDIUM-WIDE shot of her SEATED at the right end of a long review table of matte oiled walnut with no reflections, her whole body between 60% and 92% of the frame width (nothing of her crosses the centre of the frame), wearing a sleek, form-fitting BIONIC SUIT in deep navy with matte white armored plates on the shoulders, chest and forearms, thin glowing azure-blue (#0375DB) light seams along the plates; the chest plate is plain, smooth white with NO emblem, NO logo, NO symbol, NO rocket, NO lettering; no watch, no bracelet and no ring, sleek futuristic wraparound glasses with CLEAR TRANSPARENT lenses lightly tinted azure blue, a thin frameless edge and a fine glowing azure line along the top of the lenses; her eyes are clearly visible through the transparent lenses, no mirror reflection covers her eyes. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: we sit across the same table from her, the camera at her seated eye level, 85mm; the table crosses the whole width of the frame in the lower part. In front of her, on the right half of the table, lie four thin glass cards in one neat row, plain, with NO text, NO symbols and NO marks on them; the left half of the table is empty. A single fine trace of azure-blue (#0375DB) scan light runs along the four cards and up to a FIFTH card that she holds up between her fingers at chest height, which glows, caught at the exact moment she shows it to us and looks straight into the lens with a quiet, confident half-smile. The card she holds is the brightest element; a cool rim light from behind separates her from the dark; the four cards on the table stay dim. The LEFT 58% of the frame, including the empty left half of the table, is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze, no cards, no light, no objects. The near half of the table is in deep shadow, outside every light: the scan light only touches the cards and never reaches the near edge. Enormous contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand. No monitors, no plants, no lamps.

lecho.tono: DARK walnut in deep shadow, near black

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark space on the left 58% of the frame
